assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The current overall design boundary and three key-area polygons are repository-provided provisional geometries, not official planning redlines.
assumptions.impact: All draft areas, alignments, ratios, and spatial placements must be recomputed after official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-003 is treated only as a placeholder for the required Dazhongsi workstream; its current coordinates are not used to claim a station-area design location.
assumptions.impact: The Dazhongsi proposal remains a program, governance, and connectivity prototype until an official polygon and station interface are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Authoritative parcels, existing buildings, ownership, road redlines, utilities, heritage controls, public-service facilities, and implementation entities are absent from the public package.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish decisions, development intensity, exact project footprints, costs, and delivery commitments are intentionally not asserted.

assumptions.statement: Named operators and governance roles in the proposal are recommended responsibility types, not confirmed institutional commitments.
assumptions.impact: Each pilot requires a written mandate, data agreement, accessibility review, safety review, and accountable human owner before launch.
